title: AMIS Conclusion is an integration-only Conclusion opco that is small enough to decide quickly
content:
AMIS Conclusion is a new row added at the operating-company level rather than at the level of the Conclusion group. That scoping is itself the first finding: the entity able to decide is the opco, and treating the group as the counterpart would put the conversation several layers above where it can be settled.

The second is what the opco does. Integration is its whole business — the workbook lists IoT, data and integration, with the stack not verified — which matches the pre-integration endgame directly. A firm whose entire practice is connecting systems does not need convincing that the seams between systems are where the difficulty and the value sit.

Size is the third property. The research notes it is small enough to decide quickly, which together with the other two makes it a practical near-term conversation: the right subject matter, an addressable decision-maker, and no committee to route around. The unverified stack is the open item, and it is a research task rather than an objection.
